metadata.title: The COMBS Survey -- II. Distinguishing the Metal-Poor Bulge from the Halo Interlopers

notes: No eligible stars. Although the abstract refers to non-confined stars as “unbound” (T:p1-b5), the paper defines P(conf.) as the fraction of 1 Gyr orbits with apocenter < 3.5 kpc (T:p9-b3), and describes low-P(conf.) objects as halo interlopers (T:p9-b6). This is confinement to the bulge, not an explicit claim or criterion that any star is unbound from the Milky Way. No star is identified as a Galactic unbound candidate, so the entries in Table A1 (T:p17-b0) are not eligible.
